decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (1069.10.01.Exg.001; 1069.10.01.Exg.022; 1069.10.01.Exg.023; 1069.10.01.Exg.024; 1069.10.01.Exg.060; 1069.10.01.Exg.061; 1069.10.01.Exg.062; 1069.10.02.Des.002.A; 1069.10.02.Des.022.A; 1060.10.02.Des.023.A; 1069.10.02.Des.024.A; 1069.10.02.Des.060.A; 1069.10.02.Des.061.A; 1069.10.02.Des.062.A; 1069.10.03.Pln.201; Heritage Statement Ref: 2127 by Heritage Collective; Energy Strategy Report Ref: 15-1716 by Syntegra Consulting; Noise Impact Assessment by Syntegra Consulting; Transport Statement by Kronen Limited; Received 06/06/2016.) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the brick wall and railings hereby permitted shall match those used of the adjacent block.

Condition : 4 - 4.	Within 3 months of this decision, the details of cycle parking in line with policy EC2 of the Local Plan shall be submitted and approved. This area shall be permanently thereafter, in accordance with approved drawings/details, and shall not be used for any other purpose at any time.
Condition : 5 - The use hereby permitted shall not be open to customers outside the following times [23.00 - 06.00].
description: Retrospective application for the conversion of the existing vacant A3 (Restaurant) premises (ground, first and second) to B1a offices incorporating a radio station (B1) including like-for-like replacement windows on the London Road frontage at the first and second floor levels, enclosing the concrete area in front of the new part of the building (immediately behind the original curved building) with a wall and railing to match the existing, and associated cycle and car parking.
